identity.name: Qwen1.5-14B-Chat
identity.summary: Qwen1.5-14B-Chat is a chat model in the Qwen1.5 family, which includes base and chat models across multiple sizes.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Qwen1.5-14B-Chat is a text-output chat model with no reported factuality or grounding evaluations in the card summary, so it plausibly can generate factually inaccurate content.

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes an open-weight chat model that accepts text input, so users may include confidential information in prompts sent to the model.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes an open-weight chat model that accepts text input, so users may include copyrighted or other IP material in prompts sent to the model.

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes a large 14B dense decoder-only model, whose training and operation plausibly have increased carbon emissions and resource use.

specifications.model_size: 26.4 GiB of safetensors weights (28,334,637,304 bytes) in BF16
